facts.fact: 次日清晨新闻台的叫醒电话由 Smith 接到，Dan 派 Kate 去警方发布会、Smith 继续在街上找学生。
facts.anchor: Next morning it was Smith who received the wake-up call from the newsdesk.

facts.fact: 警方发布会确认死者是十九岁学生 Olivia Kavanagh，颈部有刺伤，尚无人被捕，三名室友协助调查。
facts.anchor: The victim was tragically identified as a student called Olivia Kavanagh, who was nineteen years old.

facts.fact: 警方称住宅入口和前门没有监控覆盖。
facts.anchor: There is no CCTV covering the approach to the property or the front door.

facts.fact: 被 Kate 问及与 1999 年 Emily Pierce 案是否有关，Gallagher 明确否认，称目前视为悲剧性的巧合。
facts.anchor: we are currently treating this as a tragic coincidence

facts.fact: Smith 说 Elliot 自称本学期才认识 Olivia，且与她的室友 Millie 有性关系。
facts.anchor: Sounds like he was banging her flatmate.

facts.fact: Meera 承认把 Elliot 写成 Olivia 的朋友只是“诗的许可”，她并不觉得两人熟。
Kate 留在 Otley Road 附近，因为只有她报道过 Emily 案，这是她自己的故事。
